crossRefs.note: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing…
I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

parallels.note: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.

translations.web: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
translations.bsb: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
translations.kjv: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes
translations.asv: For all his ordinances were before me, And I put not away his statutes from me.
